questions.question: Order 3/4, 5/8 and 7/10 from smallest to largest, showing your method.
Simplify 375/1000 and explain how you know your answer is in simplest form.
questions.expected_answer: Dividing by 5 three times (or by the HCF 125) gives 3/8. It is in simplest form because 3 and 8 have no common factor other than 1.
